𝗣𝗛𝗜𝗟𝗟𝗜𝗣𝗦 𝗚𝗢𝗡𝗘 𝗙𝗢𝗥 𝟭𝟭𝟴! 🇮🇳

Akash Deep bowled Phillips, ending a 216-run stand with Nicholls.
NZ 317/6 at Day 2 lunch in Wellington; Nicholls is on 146*.

Can India finish the tail? 👇

#INDvNZ #TeamIndia
